query:
SELECT e.space_id AS "space_id!: i64"
           FROM agenda_items e
           JOIN spaces sp ON sp.id = e.space_id
           WHERE e.user_id = ? AND sp.archived_at IS NULL AND e.all_day = 0
             AND e.ends_at > ? AND e.starts_at < ?
           ORDER BY e.starts_at
           LIMIT 1
